title: IAEA Live Chart: 12C is listed stable, abundance 98.94
summary: The Live Chart ground-state row for 12C says STABLE and lists abundance 98.94.
body: The IAEA Live Chart ground-state row for 12C (Z=6, N=6), extracted 2026-11-18, lists the half-life field as STABLE and the abundance field as 98.94 with unc_a 0.06. The row's ENSDF publication cut-off field is 1-Jan-2017. Abundance here is the column in that row, not a new assay.

sources.title: IAEA Live Chart ground state 12C
sources.author: International Atomic Energy Agency, Live Chart of Nuclides
sources.note: CSV row extracted 2026-11-18. ENSDF cut-off field: 1-Jan-2017.

history.note: Truth gate ceiling. The only source host is iaea.org, class other, whose ceiling is weak. The Live Chart row was not changed and no source was added.
